notes: Refers specifically to one's father's brother; a mother's brother is خَال (khāl). The plural is أَعْمَام (ʾaʿmām), and the feminine form (paternal aunt) is عَمَّة (ʿamma).
Also commonly used as a polite form of address for an older man.
